_README: Change-management hooks. These EXTEND the starter set in project-setup's
references/hooks.md — they do not replace it. Copy the blocks you want into
.claude/settings.json, substitute the project's real commands, and DELETE the rest.
Posture: coding standards bite, process advises.
- format / lint / secret-scan  -> hard gates, exit 2 to block
- spec drift, open records     -> print a warning, never block
A guard that fires on safe work gets disabled within a week, and a disabled guard
is worse than none. Keep the blocking set small and specific.
Every PreToolUse/PostToolUse hook runs on EVERY matching call. Keep them fast.
Test each one by triggering it before declaring it done.
Remove this _README key from the real settings file.

PreToolUse._comment: HARD GATE. Block a commit that stages .env or anything matching a key pattern. This is the one hook that pays for itself — a leaked key is the most expensive mistake in a solo project.

hooks.command: staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only); echo "$staged" | grep -qE '(^|/)\.env$' && { echo 'BLOCKED: .env is staged.' >&2; exit 2; }; git diff --cached -U0 | grep -qE '(sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}|-----BEGIN [A-Z ]*PRIVATE KEY-----)' && { echo 'BLOCKED: staged diff contains something shaped like a credential.' >&2; exit 2; }; exit 0

PostToolUse._comment: HARD GATE. Lint the file that was just written; exit 2 sends the failure back to be fixed. Swap in the project's real linter.

hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$f" in *.py) ruff check "$f" || exit 2 ;; *.ts|*.tsx) npx --no-install eslint "$f" || exit 2 ;; esac

Stop._comment: ADVISORY. If code under src/ changed but docs/project_spec.md did not, say so. Never blocks — the threshold rule means most changes legitimately do not touch the spec.

hooks.command: changed=$(git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null); echo "$changed" | grep -qE '^(src|app|lib)/' && ! echo "$changed" | grep -q 'docs/project_spec.md' && echo 'Note: code changed, spec did not. If this altered a requirement, amend the spec before committing.'; exit 0

SessionStart._comment: ADVISORY. List open change records so you pick up where you left off instead of doing archaeology.

hooks.command: [ -d docs/changes ] && grep -l 'status: open\|status: approved\|status: in-progress' docs/changes/*.md 2>/dev/null | head -5 | while read -r f; do sed -n 's/^title: //p' "$f" | head -1 | sed "s|^|OPEN $(basename "$f" .md): |"; done; exit 0
